info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Public Reference Data Update API
info.description: The Public Reference Data Update API provides a mechanism for updating various market data resources within the public reference data management system. This API allows authorized users to modify existing data attributes for specific financial instruments, ensuring that all market participants have access to accurate and up-to-date information. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions, data analysts, and software developers who require real-time market data adjustments. By utilizing this endpoint, organizations can maintain the integrity and reliability of their financial data ecosystem.
